title: Refund impossible: return needs a fully paid bill, bill credit needs an open bill, no cash refund
summary: Backend half is already tracked as purchase:C-P13 (decision D-11, awaiting the client). Backend: returnable = paid qty of fully paid bills; the bill credit must be applied in full to an outstanding bill of the same vendor, so a fully paid bill can never be credited; no money-back path. Frontend: the only entry is Authorize Return on a billed local PO; RETURNABLE: 0 shows a disabled box with no explanation; the Refund button opens a Bill Credit. Repro: PO-000001, VR-000001 in the shared DB.
status_evidence: reproduced in the browser, purchase test 2026-11-10
